0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Hierax would ask you a question with absolutely no ulterior motive whatsoever.

48.original: Oho! You are Azem's familiar, are you not?

49.original: I pose to you a question: imagine an object you truly desire lies before you. What do you do?

53.original: I see... As rumored, you do show a glimmer of intelligence. Avarice is a mark of sentience, you know.

54.original: Speaking of which, my pot of nectar has recently gone missing─along with the nymphai I was observing. Welcome as this confirmation of their intelligence is, they aren't meant to eat all of that at once.

55.original: Of course, should I pursue them, they will like as not hide for fear of reprisal while they devour the lot. However, they may respond if a fellow familiar expresses <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> that so much nectar truly belongs to them...if you take my meaning.

56.original: I believe I caught a glimpse of the nymphai surmounting the fence to the southwest... I assure you, you will know them when you see them.

58.original: The...nymphe?...squeaks innocently in response to your query, but you have ample reason to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> its sincerity...

60.original: The...nymphe?...squeals in a presumably disgruntled fashion and waddles away.

62.original: The...nymphe?...squeaks innocently in response to your query, but you have ample reason to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> its sincerity...

64.original: The...nymphe?...waddles away, but not before you catch a strong whiff of nectar.

66.original: The...nymphe?...squeaks innocently in response to your query, but you have ample reason to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> its sincerity...

68.original: The...nymphe?...waddles away, looking rather pleased with itself.

69.original: You've returned! But where are my nymphai?

71.original: You should probably forget about those.

73.original: What in the world are you talking about? Come now, tell me what you saw. Spare no detail─I'm a professional.

75.original: My nymphai were bright, and winged, a-and─ Oh... Oh, no...

76.original: No... No, that's absurd... Ha ha... Ha ha ha...

77.original: Tell no one of this. Some things are better off lost.
